annotations.title: Plan an EV trip with charging stops

description: Plan a drive from origin to destination and choose charging stops from the real-world range. Places are names or "lat,lng". Returns distance, drive time, ordered stops with battery levels, or feasible:false with the gap where no matching charger is in reach. Road coverage: Ukraine only. Places must be "lat,lng" coordinates; names are not accepted on this server.

batteryKwh.description: Usable battery size. Enables charge-time estimates.

chargeToPercent.description: Charge up to this level at each stop. Default 80.

connectors.description: Connector keys: CCS2, Type2, CHADEMO, GBT. Default CCS2.

maxChargeKw.description: Vehicle peak DC power. Refines charge-time estimates.

maxDetourKm.description: Max km from the route to a station. Default 5, max 15.

minPowerKw.description: Minimum station power in kW. Default 50.

minSocPercent.description: Never drop below this battery level. Default 10.

rangeKm.description: Real-world range on a full battery in km, 50–1500.

via.description: Places to pass through, in order. Up to 8.

name: plan_ev_route
